title: Preserving State Across Yields
goal: Store accumulated work in struct state so partial progress is not lost if interrupted.
hints: Look at how struct fields are accessed inside impl methods.
Without explicit self qualification, the compiler looks for a local variable named items.
explanation: To persist state across async boundaries, write to struct fields via `self.items`. Writing `items` without `self.` triggers `E0425` because no local variable by that name exists in scope. Calling `extend(val)` fails with `E0277` because `i32` does not implement `IntoIterator`.
